newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to sell December residual fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to sell December residual fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp has issued a tender to sell low sulphur heavy stock for loading between December 1-3, industry sources said on Tuesday.

Under the tender, IOC would sell 20,000 tonnes of 75 centistoke residual fuel at 100 degrees centigrade which traders said is equivalent to more than 1,000 centistoke at the normal, 50 degrees centistoke.
The 1.2 percent sulphur grade residual fuel is to be loaded from Vizag, east coast of India.
The tender closes November 21 and is closed November 22.
